ex: My trainer told me to do hip thrusts every week.
Hip thrusts make your legs and back stronger.
Can you show me how to do a hip thrust?
I do three sets of hip thrusts at the gym.
We want to go wreck diving during our vacation.
Wreck diving lets you see old ships under the sea.
Do you need special training for wreck diving?
This island is famous for its wreck diving.
She is training hard for her first fitness bikini competition.
Fitness bikini athletes need a lean but natural body.
How many women are competing in fitness bikini this year?
My sister won second place in fitness bikini.
fitness bikini.note: In competitions this category is often called "bikini fitness" or "the bikini division."

ex: My son spent all his money on loot boxes in the game.
You never know what is inside a loot box.
Some countries have rules about selling loot boxes to children.
I opened a loot box and got a rare sword.
This new phone app is a real game changer for small shops.
Working from home was a game changer for many families.
Do you think electric cars are a game changer?
For me, a good coffee machine was a game changer.
game changer.note: Means something that changes a situation in a big way. Also written "game-changer."

ex: I always use a method feeder when I fish in a lake.
Put some bait into the method feeder before you cast.
Which method feeder is best for big fish?
He caught three carp with a method feeder today.
Let's go to the karaoke club after dinner.
Is there a good karaoke club near the hotel?
We sang our favorite songs at the karaoke club.
The karaoke club is open until three in the morning.
karaoke club.note: "Karaoke bar" is more common in English.

ex: We celebrated her birthday at a karaoke bar.
Is there a karaoke bar in this part of town?
My friends love singing old songs at the karaoke bar.
The new karaoke bar has private rooms for groups.
My grandmother goes to aqua fitness classes twice a week.
Aqua fitness is good for people with back problems.
Does the hotel pool have aqua fitness in the morning?
You don't need to swim well for aqua fitness.
aqua fitness.note: In the US people usually say "water aerobics."

ex: We booked a jeep safari in the mountains for Saturday.
How long does the jeep safari take?
The jeep safari was the best part of our trip.
Bring water and a hat for the jeep safari.
My brother plays battle royale games every evening.
In a battle royale, only the last player wins.
Which battle royale game is the most popular now?
This battle royale has a hundred players in each match.
battle royale.note: Usually a type of video game where many players fight until one is left.

ex: My uncle is a member of a biker club.
The biker club rides to the lake every Sunday.
Can anyone join your biker club?
The local biker club collected money for a children's hospital.
She wore smoky eyes and red lipstick to the party.
Can you teach me how to do smoky eyes?
Smoky eyes look great for an evening event.
I need a dark eyeshadow for smoky eyes.
smoky eyes.note: Makeup artists often say "a smoky eye" or "a smoky eye look."

ex: She was named MVP of the final game.
Who do you think will be this season's MVP?
Our goalkeeper was the MVP of the tournament.
He won the MVP award two years in a row.
MVP.note: Means "most valuable player." In business it also means "minimum viable product."

ex: I need a digital detox, so I turned off my phone.
We tried a weekend digital detox at a cabin.
Have you ever done a digital detox for a week?
A digital detox can help you sleep better.
I bought a gray zip hoodie for the gym.
Do you have this zip hoodie in a larger size?
A zip hoodie is easy to take off when it gets warm.
He always wears a black zip hoodie to school.
I make a smoothie bowl with bananas for breakfast.
Can I get a smoothie bowl without nuts, please?
This cafe puts fresh fruit and seeds on its smoothie bowls.
A smoothie bowl is thicker than a normal smoothie.
Our group does advocacy for people with disabilities.
She works in advocacy for clean air in the city.
Advocacy helped change the law on animal rights.
The charity spends money on advocacy and education.
I signed up to be a beta tester for the new app.
Beta testers find bugs before the game is released.
How do I become a beta tester for this program?
The company sent free copies to its beta testers.
My grandfather loves wearing socks with an argyle pattern.
She bought a blue argyle sweater for the winter.
Argyle is a pattern of diamonds in different colors.
Do you have this vest in argyle?
argyle.note: Often used before a noun: "argyle socks", "an argyle sweater."

ex: After the match, everyone typed GG in the chat.
It's polite to say GG even when you lose.
He wrote GG and left the game.
GG, everyone! Do you want to play again?
GG.note: Short for "good game." Players type it at the end of an online game.

ex: Close the visor on your helmet before you ride.
She wears a white visor when she plays tennis.
My hockey helmet has a clear plastic visor.
Do you sell sun visors for running?
Snowboard cross is my favorite sport at the Winter Olympics.
In snowboard cross, four riders race down the course together.
Is snowboard cross harder than normal snowboarding?
She started training for snowboard cross at age twelve.
Put some aloe vera on your skin after the sun.
I keep an aloe vera plant in my kitchen.
Do you have a cream with aloe vera?
This shampoo contains aloe vera and green tea.
aloe vera.note: Usually uncountable: "aloe vera gel". For the plant, say "an aloe vera plant."

ex: I booked a spa manicure for Friday afternoon.
A spa manicure includes a hand massage and a mask.
How much does a spa manicure cost here?
She got a spa manicure before her wedding.
